run() - Method in class edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.SimpleStoryGraphTool
This method: Checks if there are no arguments or if the help option is present, and if so, prints the help text and terminates. Checks for unused arguments. Prints the title of the tool. Reads the story graph from the input source. Checks the version number of the story graph. Prints a snapshot of the graph. Runs this tool's main method as a task. Prints a snapshot of the graph after the main method. Writes the story graph to the output destination. Catches anything throwable and, if one is caught, prints its message.
